name: Under the Sycamore Tree
source:
Naomi Parker comes back to her home town Littleroot in order to take some pictures from her friend's wedding. Back luck however get's her and she is forced to stay in town longer then intended. During her stay she befriends a boy named Daniel who oddly seems familiar to her. The more she get's to know him however, the more she begins to recall the tragedy that struck someone close to her that she caused.

[From [url=http://sleiphericwingsgames.blogspot.com/2014/01/under-sycamore-tree.html]Sleipheric Wings[/url]]
